modalities.evidence: ear-EEG as a sleep monitoring platform
EEG, EOG and chin EMG electrodes
a partial PSG (EEG, EOG and chin EMG electrodes)
This has been archived as behavioral data
the subject answered a short questionnaire regarding the quality of the night's sleep

output.population: 20 healthy adults aged 22–36, each sleeping 4 nights at home; 10 of them slept a further 12 nights with ear-EEG only
output.summary: Ear-EEG sleep monitoring dataset: participants slept at home with partial polysomnography, ear-EEG and a wrist actigraph, plus post-night comfort questionnaires and sleep diaries. Some participants recorded further nights with ear-EEG only.
